name: Cherry Chocolate Brownie Trifle with Vanilla Pudding & Whipped Cream

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Betty Crocker fudge brownie mix and Jell-O instant vanilla pudding mix; if using different brands please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE BROWNIES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat the bottom and sides of a 9-inch square baking dish with a thin layer of nonstick cooking spray. Set aside.
Place brownie mix, eggs, oil, and water in a medium bowl. Stir until just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (462 g) box chocolate brownie mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Pour batter into the baking dish and spread out evenly. Place dish in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out almost clean, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, 1 hour.

TO MAKE THE PUDDING: While the brownies are baking, place milk and pudding mix in a clean medium bowl. Mix with a whisk, immersion blender, or electric mixer, until well combined and smooth, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups whole milk
1 (96 g) box instant pudding mix, vanilla-flavor

instructions.primary_message: Cover pudding with plastic wrap and refrigerate until you are ready to assemble the trifle.
TO ASSEMBLE THE TRIFLE: Cut cooled brownies into 1-inch squares.

In a medium glass bowl or trifle dish, layer half each of the brownie squares, pudding, whipped topping, and cherry pie filling. Repeat layering with remaining brownies, pudding, and whipped topping. Decorate the top as desired with remaining cherry pie filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) container whipped topping
1 (595 g) can cherry pie filling

instructions.primary_message: Allow your guests to help themselves and enjoy!
